mapper.select: SELECT id, name, official_name, en_name, tier, win_rate, pick_rate, win_rank FROM heroes WHERE name = #{name} OR official_name = #{name} OR en_name = #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, official_name, en_name, tier, ROUND(win_rate * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(pick_rate * 100, 1) AS pick_rate_pct, win_rank, version FROM heroes WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT a.name AS augment_name, a.tier_name, r.tier AS rank_tier, r.win_rank, ROUND(r.win_rate * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(r.pick_rate * 100, 1) AS pick_rate_pct FROM hero_augment_rank r JOIN augments a ON r.augment_id = a.id WHERE r.hero_id = #{heroId} ORDER BY r.win_rank ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.name AS augment_name, a.tier_name, r.win_rank, ROUND(r.win_rate * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(r.pick_rate * 100, 1) AS pick_rate_pct FROM hero_augment_rank r JOIN augments a ON r.augment_id = a.id WHERE r.hero_id = #{heroId} AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY r.win_rank ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.build_index, b.group_index, b.slot, b.item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.image_url AS item_image, b.win_rate, b.pick_rate FROM hero_item_build b JOIN items i ON b.item_id = i.id WHERE b.hero_id = #{heroId} ORDER BY b.build_index ASC, b.group_index ASC, b.slot ASC
SELECT id, name, official_name, tier, ROUND(win_rate * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(pick_rate * 100, 1) AS pick_rate_pct, win_rank FROM heroes ORDER BY win_rank ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, tier_name, description FROM augments
SELECT id, name, description, plaintext FROM items
SELECT hero_id, title, tags, blurb, passive, spells, ally_tips, enemy_tips FROM hero_profiles
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM augments
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_profiles
SELECT official_name FROM heroes WHERE official_name IS NOT NULL AND official_name != ''

SELECT e.ext_type AS extType, e.slot, i.name AS item_name, i.image_url AS item_image FROM hero_item_ext e LEFT JOIN items i ON e.item_id = i.id WHERE e.hero_id = #{heroId} ORDER BY e.ext_type ASC, e.slot ASC
SELECT name FROM augments
SELECT name FROM items WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name != ''
SELECT id, name, official_name, en_name, image_url FROM heroes WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url != ''
SELECT id, name, image_url FROM augments WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url != ''
SELECT id, name, image_url FROM items WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url != '' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, name FROM heroes WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR official_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR en_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 5
SELECT id, name FROM augments WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR en_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 5
SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR en_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 5
SELECT id, name, tier_name, description, tooltip FROM augments WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 2
SELECT win_rank, ROUND(win_rate * 100, 1) AS win_rate_pct, ROUND(pick_rate * 100, 1) AS pick_rate_pct FROM hero_augment_rank WHERE hero_id = #{heroId} AND augment_id = #{augmentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT name, plaintext, description, tags FROM items WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 2
